description: Programming barcodes for Honeywell scanners, decoded from the barcodes printed in Honeywell Voyager 1200g Quick Start Guide rather than transcribed, and re-encoded to confirm each round-trips. Organised by what a setting does; parameter codes vary by model and firmware, so check a code against the guide for your exact scanner before scanning it at hardware you care about.
